listings.caption: This code creates a GPT-2 tokenizer by calling tiktoken.get_encoding("gpt2").
listings.code:
tokenizer = tiktoken.get_encoding("gpt2")

text = (
    "Hello, do you like tea? <|endoftext|> In the sunlit terraces"
     "of someunknownPlace."
)

integers = tokenizer.encode(text, allowed_special={"<|endoftext|>"})

print(integers)

strings = tokenizer.decode(integers)

print(strings)
listings.reason: The code instantiates the GPT-2 BPE tokenizer via tiktoken.get_encoding("gpt2"), encodes a text into token IDs while allowing the special <|endoftext|> token, and decodes those IDs back to a string. It also includes an unknown-looking token ("someunknownPlace") to demonstrate BPE encoding without errors. The caption accurately describes the tokenizer creation step, and the rest of the code aligns with the section’s encode/decode demonstration.
